title: Client Experience & Retention Manager — Full-Time Remote $2000/month
description:
Client Experience & Retention Manager | Full-Time | $2,000 USD/Month



The Haus Keepers is a growing premium home cleaning company serving clients throughout the Denver, Colorado area.



We’re looking for an experienced Client Experience & Retention Manager who genuinely loves taking care of people, not just when everything is going well but especially when something has gone wrong.



This is NOT an entry-level customer service position.



We are not looking for someone who simply answers messages, follows scripts, closes tickets, or waits for a manager to tell them what to do.



We’re looking for someone who can:



* Read people and situations well

* Understand what a client is really upset about

* Handle complaints and cancellations calmly

* Protect long-term client relationships

* Recognize clients who may be at risk before they cancel

* Create thoughtful experiences that make clients feel valued

* Follow through without needing reminders

* Identify patterns and recommend improvements

* Make good judgment calls when there isn’t a perfect SOP



You will own the client experience after the sale.



---



## WHAT YOU’LL OWN



Client Experience & Relationships



* Client communication after booking

* Overall client satisfaction and relationship management

* Proactive client check-ins and follow-up

* Building strong long-term relationships with recurring clients

* Making sure promises and follow-ups never fall through the cracks

* Understanding the client’s history before making decisions



### Retention & Client Health



* Cancellation and retention conversations

* Identifying at-risk clients before they leave

* Understanding WHY a client wants to cancel instead of immediately offering a discount

* Tracking churn, saves, complaints, and client health

* Recognizing patterns that could impact retention

* Developing ideas to improve the overall client journey



### Complaints & Service Recovery



* Handling unhappy or disappointed clients

* Understanding the real problem behind a complaint

* Coordinating re-cleans and service recovery when appropriate

* Determining when a situation may require a credit, provider change, re-service, or another solution

* Following up after problems are resolved to make sure the relationship is actually repaired

* Knowing when owner involvement is necessary



### Client Delight



Client Experience isn’t only about fixing problems.



We also want our clients to feel known, remembered, appreciated, and genuinely cared for.



You’ll look for opportunities to:



* Recognize loyal and longtime clients

* Celebrate great client experiences

* Acknowledge important milestones

* Send thoughtful check-ins

* Notice opportunities for small surprise-and-delight moments

* Make clients feel like more than another name in a CRM



Going above and beyond does NOT mean constantly giving away discounts, refunds, or free services.



It means paying attention.



---



## WHAT GREAT CLIENT EXPERIENCE LOOKS LIKE TO US



Imagine a longtime recurring client suddenly starts rescheduling frequently and becomes less responsive.



They haven’t complained.



An average customer service representative may do nothing because there isn’t a ticket to solve.



A great Client Experience Manager notices the change and thinks:



“Something may be happening with this relationship. I should understand why before we receive a cancellation request.”



That is the kind of thinking we’re looking for.



We want someone who takes ownership of the relationship — not just the message in front of them.



---



## THIS ROLE REQUIRES JUDGMENT



We have SOPs, training, systems, and support.



But there will not be a script for every situation.



A mildly inconvenienced client should not receive the same response as a longtime client who is deeply disappointed.



A cancellation caused by price should not automatically be handled the same way as a cancellation caused by inconsistent service.



A client asking for a refund may not actually be upset about the money.



Sometimes someone needs a solution.



Sometimes they need reassurance.



Sometimes they simply need to feel heard.



You need to be able to recognize the difference.



---



## OUR COMMUNICATION STYLE



Our communication should feel:



Warm

Human

Thoughtful

Premium

Reassuring

Personal



We are friendly but not overly casual.



We want clients to feel genuinely cared for while also feeling completely confident that the person helping them knows what they’re doing.



Being able to read the room is extremely important.



You should know when a conversation can be playful and light and when the situation requires more thoughtfulness, maturity, and emotional weight.



---



## YOU MAY BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:



* Have at least 3 years of Customer Success, Client Experience, Account Management, Hospitality, or similar high-touch client experience

* Have personally handled complaints, cancellations, escalations, and retention conversations

* Have worked directly with U.S.-based clients

* Have excellent spoken and written English

* Can communicate naturally without sounding robotic or scripted

* Can remain calm when a client is emotional or frustrated

* Care deeply about people without carrying every complaint personally

* Naturally notice when something feels “off” in a client relationship

* Think beyond the immediate problem

* Ask good questions before jumping to a solution

* Take ownership without constant direction

* Follow through without needing reminders

* Communicate proactively when something is blocked or going wrong

* Learn from feedback and apply it to future situations

* Are comfortable making judgment calls within company guidelines

* Enjoy solving problems that don’t always have an obvious answer

* Recognize patterns and bring recommendations to leadership

* Think about outcomes, not just task completion

* Are highly organized and comfortable documenting client history and outcomes

* Naturally look for ways to make people feel appreciated



---



## THIS POSITION IS PROBABLY NOT A FIT IF YOU:



* Prefer repetitive work with a clear script for every situation

* Want a traditional customer support or ticket-response role

* Feel uncomfortable having difficult conversations

* Find regular complaints or cancellations emotionally overwhelming

* Prefer waiting for a manager to tell you what to do when something unexpected happens

* Focus primarily on completing tasks rather than understanding the outcome

* Avoid unhappy clients or escalations

* Struggle to adjust your communication style depending on the situation

* Need frequent reminders to follow up or complete commitments

* Prefer reacting to client problems rather than proactively protecting relationships



---



## TEAM CULTURE



This is primarily a Client Experience position but we care deeply about the experience of the people inside our company too.



We have a close, collaborative team and we want someone who naturally contributes to that culture.



That means:



* Celebrating team wins

* Sharing meaningful client compliments

* Recognizing great work

* Communicating respectfully across departments

* Helping create an environment where people feel appreciated

* Caring about the success of the entire company, not only your individual responsibilities



You will not be responsible for managing every department or owning the entire team culture.



We simply want someone who naturally makes the people around them better.



---



## SCHEDULE



Full-Time

Monday–Friday

8:00 AM–5:00 PM Mountain Time



You must be consistently available during U.S. business hours.



---



## COMPENSATION



$2000 USD per month with room to grow based on demonstrated skills



* Client Experience judgment

* Written and verbal communication

* Retention experience

* Service recovery skills

* Emotional resilience

* Relationship-building

* Independent ownership



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with The Haus Keepers long-term.



---



## HOW WE HIRE



We care much more about how you think than how impressive your resume sounds.



Our application includes real Client Experience situations because we want to understand:



If this sounds like the kind of work you’re genuinely excited to own, we’d love to hear from you.



COMPLETE THE APPLICATION HERE:







Important: Applications submitted only through OnlineJobs.ph without completing the application above will not move forward in our hiring process.

title: U.S. Accounting Specialist / Senior Bookkeeper - Trucking & Logistics
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking an experienced Philippines-based U.S. Accounting Specialist / Senior Bookkeeper to support a U.S. trucking and logistics operation.



This is not a general virtual-assistant position. We need someone capable of taking substantial ownership of day-to-day bookkeeping and accounting while communicating effectively with management and U.S. accounting/tax professionals.



Location: Philippines - Remote

Employment: Full-time

Compensation: $1,200 - $1,600 per month, depending on experience and demonstrated skill.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Perform bank and credit-card reconciliations.

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.

- Prepare and track customer invoices.

- Record and reconcile vendor payments.

- Coordinate with U.S.-based CPA/tax professionals when necessary.

- Experience supporting U.S. businesses.

- Strong QuickBooks Online skills.

- Strong knowledge of AP, AR, reconciliations and month-end close.

- Ability to prepare and understand financial statements.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong attention to detail.

- Reliable internet and professional remote-work environment.

- Ability to overlap part of the workday with U.S. Eastern Time.



PREFERRED



- Trucking, transportation, freight brokerage or logistics accounting experience.

- Factoring reconciliation experience.

- Experience with fleet expenses, fuel and maintenance.

- Driver/carrier settlement experience.

- Experience working with U.S. CPAs/accounting firms.



SCREENING QUESTIONS - PLEASE ANSWER ALL OF THE FOLLOWING IN YOUR APPLICATION

2. Rate your QuickBooks Online ability from 1-10 and explain your rating.

5. Have you handled trucking, transportation or logistics accounting?

6. Have you worked with factoring companies or reconciled factoring transactions?

7. Describe an accounting problem you discovered and corrected.

8. What hours can you work in Philippine time, and how much U.S. Eastern Time overlap can you provide?

9. What accounting software have you used besides QuickBooks?

10. Begin your application with "ACCOUNTS BALANCE" so we know you read the entire posting.



HIRING PROCESS



Finalists may be asked to complete a short paid practical accounting assessment before a hiring decision is made.

title: U.S. Business Credit & Funding Specialist
description:
POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking an experienced U.S. Business Credit & Funding Specialist to assist management with developing legitimate business-credit profiles, researching financing opportunities, preparing financing documentation and maintaining funding readiness for U.S. businesses.



This is not a consumer credit-repair position. We want someone who understands legitimate U.S. business credit, commercial lending and underwriting.



Experience with trucking, transportation, equipment financing or commercial vehicle financing is highly desirable.



Location: Philippines - Remote

Employment: Full-time preferred

Compensation: $900 - $1,300 per month, depending on experience and demonstrated skill.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Review and monitor business credit profiles.

- Research commercial financing opportunities.

- Help maintain accurate and strong business-credit profiles.

- Monitor D&B, Experian Business and Equifax Business information when applicable.

- Research business credit cards and commercial lines of credit.

- Assist with equipment and commercial vehicle financing.

- Organize lender-required documentation.

- Maintain a funding/application pipeline.

- Track applications, approvals, inquiries and lender requirements.

- Research lender underwriting criteria.

- Evaluate whether companies are funding-ready before applications are submitted.

- Assist with SBA/commercial lending documentation when appropriate.

- Review UCC filing information when relevant.

- Maintain accurate spreadsheets and CRM records.

- Coordinate with accounting staff to ensure financial documentation is lender-ready.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Experience with U.S. business credit, commercial lending, business funding, loan processing, underwriting support or a closely related field.

- Understanding of U.S. business credit reports.

- Understanding of commercial lending and lender qualification criteria.

- Strong research and analytical skills.

- Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.

- Excellent English communication.

- High ethical standards.

- Ability to handle confidential financial information appropriately.



PREFERRED



- Equipment-finance experience.

- Commercial vehicle or trucking-finance experience.

- SBA loan preparation experience.

- Business LOC and business credit-card experience.

- Experience with D&B, Experian Business and Equifax Business.

- Experience working with U.S. lenders or financing companies.



COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS



We are interested only in legitimate business-credit and funding practices.



Candidates must not use or recommend:



- CPNs or synthetic identities.

- False financial information.

- False revenue or income representations.

- Fraudulent documentation.

- Misleading lender applications.

- Unauthorized credit applications.

- Any strategy intended to deceive lenders or credit bureaus.



The specialist may research opportunities and prepare applications, but management retains final authorization before any credit or financing application is submitted.



SCREENING QUESTIONS - PLEASE ANSWER ALL OF THE FOLLOWING IN YOUR APPLICATION



1. How many years have you worked with U.S. business credit or commercial financing?

10. Begin your application with "FUNDING READY" so we know you read the entire posting.



HIRING PROCESS

- AI tools

- Strong attention to detail

title: Content Editor & Strategist
description:
Content Editor & Strategist 



JOB TITLE: Content Editor & Strategist 



TYPE: Full time, remote, long term



HOURS: 40 hours per week, with some overlap with New York hours



SALARY: $800 to $1,100/month depending on experience



Read the whole post. There's an application instruction at the bottom and I skip anyone who misses it.



WHO WE ARE



A family-owned jeweler in New York City's Diamond District. Diamonds, engagement rings, and luxury watches, made in our own shop.



The footage is good and it's the kind most brands can't get. A real workshop, a real trading floor, and customers having the biggest day of their life on camera. Right now I shoot and edit all of it myself, and the editing is what's slowing everything down.



THE ROLE, IN ONE SENTENCE



I shoot. You make it good and tell me what to shoot next.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Editing:



Cut short-form video for Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

Turn one shoot into several genuinely different videos, each with its own hook

Captions, on-screen text, pacing, sound, hook timing

Native edits per platform, no watermarked cross-posts

Keep the footage library organized



Strategy:



Watch the market weekly and bring me formats that are working before I ask

Bring me shoot ideas every week, not just execution of mine

Watch retention, sends, and non-follower reach, and tell me in plain language what you're seeing

Tell me when an idea is bad or a hook is weak. I'd rather argue for ten minutes than post something flat



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



Someone who thinks like a creator, not a service provider.



Real short-form editing experience with links to prove it

You use TikTok and Reels yourself and have opinions about what's working

Strong written English. You'll be writing hooks and captions in an American voice

Organized and self-directed



You don't need a film degree, a jewelry background, or expensive gear. Most of our footage is shot on a phone on purpose.



WHO I'M NOT LOOKING FOR



An editor who slaps auto-captions on a clip, cuts wherever, adds a trending sound for no reason, and sends it back. That's the job I'm trying to stop doing myself.



I'm also not looking for someone who only ever agrees with me.



WHY THIS IS A GOOD ONE



Full time, stable, long term, with a real budget behind it

Tools and subscriptions paid for

You work directly with me. No layers, no account manager, no client calls

Your ideas actually get shot. This is a creative seat, not a queue

A luxury brand and a category you'll be proud to put in your portfolio

Raises tied to results

Path to leading a small content team



HOW TO APPLY



Two or three links to short-form videos you edited. One line each on what you were going for.

Answer this: pick any jewelry or luxury brand on TikTok or Instagram. Tell me one thing they're doing that works and one thing you'd change. Three sentences.

Start your message with the word DIAMOND.



Anything missing all three gets skipped.

title: Bookkeeping / Data entry
description:
Virtual Assistant – Property Accounting & Utility Reconciliation

Full-Time or Part-Time | Long-Term Position | Real Estate Company



We are an established real estate investment, development, and property management company in Illinois, USA. We are looking for a highly organized, accurate, and dependable Virtual Assistant to help us with utility bill reconciliation, data entry, bookkeeping support, and property accounting.

This is intended to be a long-term position. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, pays close attention to numbers, stays on top of assignments, and does not need to be constantly reminded about unfinished tasks.

Initial Responsibilities



Your primary responsibilities will include:

Reviewing utility bills, including ComEd (electric), North Shore Gas, water/sewer, and other property utilities

Matching utility accounts and bills to the correct properties and units

Entering and organizing utility information

Reconciling bills, payments, and account records

Identifying missing bills, duplicate charges, incorrect property assignments, unusual charges, or discrepancies

Maintaining spreadsheets and utility/account tracking records

Entering and reviewing information in QuickBooks

Assisting with accounts payable and basic bookkeeping

Organizing invoices, statements, and other accounting documents

Following up on incomplete items and maintaining a clear list of outstanding issues

Providing regular updates on completed work and items requiring attention

As you learn our business and demonstrate your abilities, the position may expand into additional bookkeeping and accounting responsibilities.



Who We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is:

Extremely detail-oriented and accurate with numbers

Organized and disciplined

Experienced with bookkeeping, accounting support, or financial data entry

Experienced with QuickBooks Online

Strong with Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets

Comfortable reconciling accounts and investigating discrepancies

Able to work independently and stay focused

Able to follow established procedures consistently

Comfortable asking questions when something does not make sense instead of guessing

Able to manage repetitive work without losing accuracy

Reliable with deadlines and follow-up

Interested in a stable, long-term working relationship

Experience working with a U.S. real estate, property management, bookkeeping, or accounting company is a major advantage.

Very Important

We are not simply looking for the fastest data-entry person.

Accuracy is more important to us than speed.

We want someone who will notice if:

A utility bill is assigned to the wrong property

An account number does not match

A bill appears to be missing

A payment does not reconcile

A charge is unusually high or low

The same bill appears twice

Something simply does not look correct

We value a person who will stop, investigate, and ask questions rather than enter incorrect information just to finish the task.

Software / Skills

Experience with the following is preferred:

QuickBooks Online

Microsoft Excel

Google Sheets

Google Drive

PDF invoices and statements


Basic accounting and bookkeeping principles



To Apply

Please include the following in your application:

How many years of bookkeeping/accounting experience do you have?

How many years have you used QuickBooks Online?

Have you worked for a U.S.-based company before?

Have you worked in real estate or property management?

Describe a reconciliation task you have handled in a previous position.

If you find that an invoice does not match the accounting records, what steps would you take?

What is your current availability and how many hours per week can you work?

At the very beginning of your application, write the words “UTILITY RECONCILIATION.” This is required so we know you carefully read the entire job posting.

We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted, long-term member of our team. Strong performance can lead to increased responsibilities in bookkeeping and accounting.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Reels & TikTok (Beauty / Aesthetics Niche)
description:
We're launching a new direct-to-consumer beauty / aesthetics service targeting European markets (France, Poland, Spain, Italy). Our growth engine is short-form video on Instagram Reels + TikTok — high-volume, fast-iteration content modeled on accounts that have proven the format in this niche.



We need a video editor who can produce 3–5 polished reels per week in our brand template. You'll work from raw footage + b-roll + brand assets that we provide. Your job is to assemble, pace, and finish the cut: text overlays, motion graphics, captions, sound design, color.



You'll edit ONE master reel per concept, then produce localized variants by swapping text layers and audio (we supply translations + AI-generated voiceovers via ElevenLabs / DeepL / Submagic). The editing template is built once, then re-skinned 4 times.



--- WHAT YOU'LL DO ---



EDITING

- 3–5 reels per week, 15–60 seconds each

- Cut to trending audio + hooks designed to retain viewers in the first 0.5 second

- Motion graphics: text reveals, side-by-side comparisons, zoom-in highlights, arrow callouts, ratio overlays

- Color grade and sound design to a consistent brand look

- Build Premiere templates so locale variants take under 20 minutes each



LOCALIZATION WORKFLOW

- Take 1 master edit and output 4 localized variants (French / Polish / Spanish / Italian)

- Swap text overlays from a translation sheet we supply

- Replace voiceover track with locale-appropriate AI audio we provide

- QC each variant for timing, kerning, and line-breaks per language (text length varies)



ASSET MANAGEMENT

- Organize project files in a clean folder structure (Google Drive)

- Maintain a "concept library" of reusable templates

- Tag and archive raw footage so we can repurpose later



FEEDBACK LOOP

- Light weekly analytics review: which hooks / edits get the most retention

- Iterate the template based on what's working



--- REQUIRED SKILLS (must-have — do not apply without these) ---

- 2+ years editing short-form social video (Reels / TikTok / Shorts)

- Strong CapCut AND Premiere Pro (or DaVinci Resolve / After Effects)

- Motion graphics: text animation, masks, keyframe tracking

- Comfortable working from a brand style guide (fonts, colors, beat timing)

- Fast turnaround: you can deliver a finished reel in under 4 hours from raw footage

- Functional written English — enough to read briefs and reply with questions. Doesn't have to be fluent; we use translation tools both ways.

- Portfolio of edits in the beauty / aesthetics / lifestyle / fashion niche specifically



--- NICE-TO-HAVE ---

- Experience editing beauty-education / aesthetic content

- Familiarity with trending TikTok audio sourcing

- AI tools workflow: ElevenLabs voiceover swaps, automatic captions (Submagic, Captions.ai)

- Speak any of French / Polish / Spanish / Italian (big bonus for QC'ing localized variants — NOT required)

- Some Photoshop / Illustrator for thumbnail and asset prep



--- COMPENSATION ---

$700/month for the first 30-day paid trial (3 master reels/week, deliver on time, hit our quality bar). Bumps to $900–1,100/month after a successful trial. Plus 13th-month and a performance bonus tied to retention metrics (average % watched on the reels you cut).



--- HOURS ---

Approx. 30–40h/week. Mostly async, but available at least 2 hours/day overlap with CET (so ~3 PM – 5 PM Manila time minimum).



--- TO APPLY, SEND ME ---

1. Your reel: a 60-second showreel of your best short-form edits, with timestamps indicating which clips are yours.

2. 3 links to specific reels you edited that performed well (we will check the metrics).

3. Your CapCut OR Premiere project file for ONE of those reels, so we can see your timeline and layer organization (you can scrub client names).

4. The word reels at the very top of your reply so we know you read this whole post.

5. Your salary expectation.



Applications missing any of these will be ignored.

title: Personal Injury Intake Specialist (Remote)
description:
Personal Injury Intake Specialist (Remote)



Crooks Law Firm | Full-Time | 100% Remote



About the Role



We're a personal injury law firm looking for an experienced Intake Specialist to be the first voice a potential client hears. People call us on what is often the worst week of their life — after a car wreck, a fall, a workplace injury. Your job is to make them feel heard, get the facts we need, and move qualified cases into our pipeline quickly and cleanly.



This is a fully remote position. You'll need a quiet home workspace, reliable high-speed internet, and the discipline to stay productive without someone looking over your shoulder.



What You'll Do

Answer inbound calls, web form submissions, chats, and texts from potential clients — usually within minutes, not hours

Conduct compassionate but thorough intake interviews: how the injury happened, treatment received, insurance coverage, police reports, witnesses, prior claims

Screen cases against our firm's criteria and escalate strong leads to an attorney the same day

Follow up persistently on leads that don't sign on the first contact — most cases are won or lost in the follow-up

Send, track, and chase down retainer agreements and HIPAA authorizations through e-signature

Enter and maintain accurate, detailed records in our case management system (Filevine / Litify / Clio or similar)

Politely decline and refer out cases that aren't a fit, without burning the relationship

Hit response-time, contact-attempt, and conversion benchmarks tracked weekly

What You Need

1–3 years of intake experience at a personal injury firm (or a legal call center handling PI leads)

Working knowledge of PI basics: statutes of limitation, liability vs. damages, UM/UIM, med pay, letters of protection

Genuine phone presence — warm, calm, and able to control a conversation with an upset or rambling caller

Strong typing and note-taking; you can capture a full intake while staying engaged on the call

Comfort with case management software, e-signature platforms, and CRM/lead tracking

Home office with a quiet, private space and reliable internet

Availability to work our core business hours, with occasional evening or weekend rotation for after-hours leads

title: Client Care and Inside Sales Coordinator: $6 Per Hour + Benefits and Performance Incentives
description:
Long Term Growth Opportunity to Become Office Manager



Job Description



Important: Cover Letter, Résumé, and Voice Recording Required to Apply



Attention to detail is essential for this position. To be considered, you must submit every item requested in the application section at the bottom of this job post.



Please review your application carefully and test all files and links before submitting. Incomplete applications will not be eligible for the second round. Due to the number of applications, we will not contact candidates to request missing information.



Do you love providing excellent service in a support based role?



Do you thrive in a fast paced environment, managing a variety of tasks? Do you love talking to customers and providing excellent customer service? Keep reading!



About Boulder Pro Painters



Boulder Pro Painters is a growing residential and commercial painting company serving Boulder, Colorado. We are committed to becoming one of the most trusted and highly reviewed painting companies in our area by providing excellent craftsmanship and an amazing customer experience.



We are a very entrepreneurial company, and we believe strongly in taking care of our customers and taking care of our amazing team members by providing a great work environment and career growth opportunities.



We value integrity, responsibility, and life balance. We believe work should empower your life, not take away from it. You should love where you work, be treated well, be part of a great team, and have opportunities to grow in your career.



Our growth and success depend on the culture we are creating. Our team is made up of ambitious and dependable people who are committed to personal growth, professional development, and producing great results.



In this role, you will work directly with me, the Founder and CEO of Boulder Pro Painters. You will help me manage customer communication, lead qualification, scheduling, follow up, marketing support, and the daily organization of the business.



This is an important, long term role with the opportunity to learn the business, take ownership of your responsibilities, increase your hours, and grow into our Office Manager as the company continues to grow.



Your Role and What You’ll Be Doing



We’re committed to creating an extraordinary company that provides excellent customer service for our customers. We want our customers talking about what an amazing experience they had working with Boulder Pro Painters. We want customers for life.



This role is a large part of that. Here are a few things you’ll be doing regularly:



* Answering the company phone line. In this business, it’s important that when customers call, someone answers or responds promptly.



* Making initial calls to customers who have requested an estimate.



* Asking qualification questions to understand the customer’s goals, project, location, timeline, and expectations.



* Following up with customers who have requested an estimate and setting appointments for me to meet with them and provide estimates.



* Managing estimate appointments in my calendar.



* Confirming appointments and handling cancellations and rescheduling requests.



* Following up with leads who have not responded or scheduled an appointment.



* Following up with customers who received an estimate but have not made a decision.



* Managing our social media pages and posting daily. This includes posting on our
 and Instagram pages and maintaining our Google Business Profile.



* Managing some of our online marketing channels by responding promptly and professionally to potential customers.



* Responding to customer comments, messages, and inquiries received through our social media and online platforms.



* Updating our CRM and lead tracker with accurate customer information, notes, appointments, and follow up activities.



* Keeping my calendar and daily priorities organized.



* Sending appointment confirmations, reminders, and routine customer communications.



* Supporting me with administrative responsibilities and the daily organization of the business.



As you learn our processes and demonstrate your ability, you will take on additional responsibilities, including:



* Reconnecting with old leads who may still need painting services.



* Reconnecting with past customers about future projects.



* Requesting customer reviews and referrals.



* Reaching out to property managers, real estate agents, designers, and other potential referral partners.



* Supporting customers after their project is approved.



* Sending routine project updates and helping customers understand the next steps.



* Tracking outstanding customer decisions, colors, scheduling details, and project information.



* Helping improve our call scripts, communication processes, and internal systems.



* Preparing simple lead, estimate, appointment, and follow up reports.



* Helping organize customer information, company files, and routine administrative records.



* Taking ownership of additional office management responsibilities as the company grows.



 Who We Are Looking For: About You



* You thrive in a fast paced work environment.



* You love being in a support role, and you love making other people’s lives easier.



* You enjoy talking with customers, and you get satisfaction from providing customers with an amazing experience each and every time you interact with them.



* You are a natural communicator, and you’re very comfortable talking on the phone.



* You speak and write excellent English and can communicate naturally and confidently with customers in the United States.



* People say you have great energy. You’re a positive, optimistic person.



* You’re a go getter. You don’t need to be told what to do at every step.



* You are proactive and always looking for what else you can provide to the business and the team.



* You are highly organized and pay close attention to details.



* You follow through on your commitments without needing repeated reminders.



* You take ownership when something needs to be completed.



* You can follow an established process while still having a natural conversation.



* You are comfortable asking qualification questions and discussing project expectations.



* You can manage multiple conversations, appointments, follow ups, and responsibilities without losing track of important details.



* You can move between phone calls, scheduling, customer communication, CRM updates, and marketing support while maintaining accuracy.



* You are comfortable receiving feedback, practicing calls, and continuously improving.



* You want a stable, long term position where you can grow with the company.



* You are available to transition into a full time overnight schedule as your training and responsibilities increase.



* You have reliable high speed internet, a dependable computer, a professional headset, and a quiet workspace.



* You have a dependable backup plan for power or internet interruptions.



Previous experience in inside sales, customer service, appointment setting, office administration, social media support, or supporting a United States based company is preferred.



Experience with a home service company, Google Workspace, GoHighLevel, CRM systems, scheduling software,
, Instagram, or Google Business Profile is helpful but not required.



We are willing to train the right person who has the right attitude, communication skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.



Compensation and Job Details



* This is a remote, long term position for candidates located in the Philippines.



* The position will begin with a paid 30 day introductory and training period of approximately 20 hours per week.



* Initial working hours will generally be Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. Mountain Time.



* The current corresponding schedule in the Philippines is approximately 10:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m.



* The position is intended to increase to 30 to 40 hours per week within approximately 30 to 60 days as training is completed, performance is demonstrated, and additional responsibilities are transferred.



* Candidates must have the availability and desire to transition to full time.



* Full time working hours will be Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time, with a one hour unpaid meal break.



* The current corresponding full time schedule in the Philippines is approximately 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.



* Colorado observes daylight saving time, so the corresponding Philippine schedule will shift by one hour during the year.



* Your starting compensation is $6 USD per hour.



* You will receive an additional $5 USD for every qualified estimate you personally schedule that is completed.



* To qualify for the incentive, the appointment must meet our established service area, project type, customer, timeline, and investment guidelines. It must also be documented correctly in the CRM and attended by the homeowner.



* The incentive does not apply to canceled appointments, missed appointments, duplicate leads, disqualified projects, self scheduled appointments, or appointments scheduled by another team member.



* You’ll be paid twice per month.



* Paid training is included.



* Your performance and compensation will be formally reviewed after your first 90 days.



* Strong performers may receive an increase to $7 USD per hour after the 90 day review.



* You will receive prorated 13th month compensation based on your regular base pay and time worked during the calendar year.



* Paid time off will be available after successfully completing the first 90 days.



* Additional performance incentives, raises, and promotions are available to top performers.



* This position has the opportunity to grow into our Office Manager as Boulder Pro Painters continues to grow.



This is more than a short term virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted member of our team, understand how the company operates, and take on greater responsibility over time.



Our business is growing, and we’re looking to hire someone within the next two to four weeks as soon as we find the right fit.



Does this job sound like a good fit for you? Do you sound like the kind of person we are looking for?



We’d love to hear from you.



To Apply, Please Submit All Eight Items



1. A cover letter explaining why you are interested in this position and why you believe you are the person we are looking for.



2. Your current résumé.



3. A one to two minute voice recording introducing yourself and describing your customer service, inside sales, office administration, or social media experience.



4. Confirmation that you can work the initial part time schedule and transition into the required full time Mountain Time schedule.



5. Your availability in both Philippine Time and Mountain Time.



6. A description of your internet connection and backup plan for power or internet interruptions.



7. Confirmation of whether you are currently working for any other clients or employers. If yes, include your current working schedule.



8. Your brief answer to this question:



A homeowner requested an estimate but did not answer your first call. What would you do next?



Before submitting, confirm that all files and links work and that anyone with the link can access them.



Incomplete applications will not be eligible for the second round. Due to the number of applications, we will not contact candidates to request missing information.



Best,



Jonathan Ramirez

Founder & CEO

Boulder Pro Painters

title: WordPress + Elementor Web Designer
description:
**About the role**



We run two established Australian trade businesses, an electrical services company and a security installation company covering CCTV, alarms, intercoms and access control. Both are licensed, insured and well reviewed, and both need to convert website visitors and Google Ads clicks into calls and form leads.



We want a WordPress and Elementor designer on an ongoing, long-term retainer. One designer handles both brands. You will not be building portfolio pieces. You will build lead machines that load fast, look clean, and convert.



You work directly with the business owner and with our SEO and Google Ads specialists. We operate with clear briefs and fast feedback.



**What you will do**



Design and build conversion-focused pages in WordPress with Elementor

Build landing pages for Google Ads that lift conversions and Quality Score

Create and improve service pages and suburb pages for local SEO

Keep everything mobile-first, since most of our traffic is on phones

Optimise page speed and Core Web Vitals

Place calls to action, click-to-call, forms and trust signals where they convert

Test forms, links and tracking before anything goes live

Keep both brands consistent using the brand kits we provide



**Must have**



5+ years building WordPress sites with Elementor, with live examples you can show us

Real conversion-focused design: CTA placement, trust signals, clean section flow, mobile-first

Strong page speed discipline. Image compression, lightweight builds, no slider bloat

Solid understanding of local SEO page structure, including service pages, suburb pages, headings, internal links and FAQs

Clear written English and reliability with deadlines

Comfortable working section by section with an owner and two specialists

Experience with trades or home service businesses such as electricians, plumbers, HVAC, security, locksmiths or builders

Experience building Google Ads landing pages, with an understanding of message match and Quality Score

Core Web Vitals and performance tuning

GA4 and Google Tag Manager, or comfort embedding tracking and testing it

Comfortable using AI tools to work faster on CSS snippets, troubleshooting and drafts, and validating the output before publishing

Basic HTML and CSS for small changes without leaning on plugins



**Tools**



WordPress, Elementor Pro, a lightweight theme such as Hello or Astra, GA4, GTM, PageSpeed Insights, and a form and tracking setup we will share. Figma or Canva for mockups is a plus.



**Schedule and pay**



Part-time, ongoing retainer with consistent weekly work

Timezone overlap with Sydney required. We are two to three hours ahead of Philippine time, so the overlap is easy

Probationary rate for the first 30 to 60 days, then an increase based on performance and speed

Paid regularly via Wise 

No upfront or advance payments. A short paid test is required for final candidates before we commit



This is a long-term role for the right person. We would rather train and keep one reliable designer than churn through many.



**How to apply**



Start your message with the word VOLTAGE so we know you read the full post. We won't open applications without it.

Two or three live Elementor sites you built, links, not screenshots. Trades or local service examples preferred.

Your monthly rate expectation for part-time ongoing work, plus your weekly availability and timezone.

Short answers to these:

What are the top five things you do to keep an Elementor site fast?

What is different about a landing page built for Google Ads versus a normal service page?

Have you built service or suburb pages for local SEO before? Give one example.

title: AI Video Creator & Editor (Higgsfield, CapCut, ElevenLabs)
description:
Read this first: this is not a general video editing job. You must already be creating videos with AI tools. If you have never generated a shot with AI yourself, this is not for you.



THE WORK



We are a new European jewelry brand, launching soon. Video is how we reach customers, and you will make all of it.



I write the brief — concept, angle, references. You turn it into a finished video. Multiple styles: AI UGC (a person on camera talking about the product), cartoon and animated pieces, product shots, ASMR, and formats we have not tried yet.



AI generation is the most important part of this job. Editing can be learned. What is rare is knowing how to pull a specific shot out of an AI tool — the right prompt, the right references, the right model, and the patience to regenerate until it is actually good instead of "close enough."



You get a paid Higgsfield account from us. You never pay for tools or credits.



WHAT YOU DO



Generate video shots with AI (mainly Higgsfield) from written briefs

Build finished short-form videos: hook, pacing, structure, ending

Edit in CapCut

Create and sync voice overs in ElevenLabs

Design text overlays that are readable and correctly timed

Choose and edit music and sound

Deliver the right formats and ratios for social and paid ads

Iterate on feedback and keep your files organized



MUST HAVE



Provable experience generating video with AI. Higgsfield preferred; Veo, Sora, Kling, Runway and Hailuo also count — as long as you personally made the work.

CapCut, at a level where editing is not your bottleneck

ElevenLabs or similar AI voice tools

A portfolio of short-form video you made yourself

An eye for what makes someone stop scrolling in two seconds

Good written English, fast replies, able to work from a written brief

Reliable internet and a computer that handles video work



NICE TO HAVE



Jewelry, fashion or beauty experience · Meta and TikTok ad creatives · AI image generation (Nano Banana, Midjourney, Flux) · After Effects · a sense for sound design



HOURS



Full-time, 40 hours minimum. If you can do 50, I want that, and I pay for every hour. One person, one brand — not five clients at once. Long-term.



PAY — READ CAREFULLY, IT IS UNUSUAL



The hourly rate is low. On purpose.



Base: $3/hour. About $520 per month at 40 hours a week, $650 at 50.



That is not meant to be your salary. It is the floor under a bonus structure far more aggressive than anything else on this site, because I want you earning from results, not from hours logged.



Every video you make runs as a paid ad. You get paid on what it sells:



10 sales ? $25

25 sales ? $70

100+ sales within 30 days ? $250

50,000+ organic views ? $25 (paid separately, on top)



The milestones stack. You are paid every tier your video passes, not only the highest one. 30 sales = $25 + $70 = $95. A winner doing 100+ sales in 30 days = $345 in total.



No cap on how many of your videos can hit these. One real winner pays you more than a month of hourly work.



These numbers are a starting framework, not carved in stone. We are brand new and have no historical data yet. Once we see real numbers, the structure may be adjusted, or tied to different benchmarks — output volume, or a mix of volume and sales. We d
 that together, in conversation. What will not change: strong results get paid well.



Two rules so we never argue about a payout. Sales are counted in Meta Ads Manager, per creative. A re-edit of an existing video does not count as a new video unless it genuinely becomes one.



You see every number — sales, spend, views. No black box.



Why the bonuses are this high: we are at the very start. No revenue, no proven funnel, no brand recognition. I cannot pay a big salary right now, so instead I give away a far bigger share of the upside than someone joining in two years will ever get. This is a founding-team deal.



The trade, stated plainly: you carry some of the risk with me now, and you get paid disproportionately when it works.



This job is for someone who thinks like an owner. Someone who asks what the video is supposed to DO, watches the results, notices which hook worked, and comes back with a better idea before I ask for one. If you want to clock in, execute the brief exactly, and clock out, please apply somewhere else — honestly, no hard feelings.



Not for you if you need a guaranteed high income starting next month. The upside is real, but it is not instant.



HOW TO APPLY



No portfolio = deleted unread. Sorry, I get too many.



Send me:



Your portfolio. Links to short-form video you made. Say what your role was on each one.

Proof of your AI work. Two or three videos where you generated the footage yourself. Which tool, and what your process was. A raw generation next to the finished edit is even better.

Which tools you use, and for how long.

How many hours a week you can commit, and confirm you have read the pay structure.

The word GOLDFISH at the top of your message, so I know you read this.



Answer these as well:



What is the last video you made that you are proud of, and why?

When an AI tool keeps giving you the wrong shot, what do you actually do about it?

Have you ever made a video that measurably sold something?

Any experience with jewelry, fashion or beauty?



Process: portfolio shortlist ? one short unpaid test (a single AI-generated shot, roughly 30 minutes) ? a paid trial project at your full rate ? ongoing full-time role.



I reply to everyone who follows these instructions.

title: Full-Cycle B2B Sales Closer | Source, Cold Call and Close | CAD $8-10/hr + 10% Commission
description:
# Full-Cycle B2B Sales Representative



**Wholesale, Marketing Services & Subscription Software**



**Employment:** Full-time, 40 hours per week

**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time

**Location:** Remote



## About Us



Wick of Hope is a Canadian candle company selling wholesale to retailers across Canada and the United States. Our customers include gift shops, boutiques, home stores, and larger accounts that reorder every season.



The same owners also run Launch & Found. One side of the business is a marketing agency serving local businesses across Canada and the US through websites, Google and Meta advertising, and SEO.



The other side is software. We build our own subscription products in-house. Some are already selling, several are approaching launch, and future products will take us into markets beyond the local businesses we serve today.



One small team supports both companies. Most of your week will be spent growing Wick of Hope’s wholesale business. The rest will be focused on selling Launch & Found’s marketing services and growing portfolio of software products.



## The Role



This is a full-cycle outbound sales position. You will be responsible for building the pipeline, creating the opportunity, and closing the deal.



On the wholesale side, you will own the buyer relationship from the first cold call through the first purchase order and then keep that account reordering. You will identify suitable independent retailers, reach the person who d
 what goes on the shelf, present our line sheet, handle pricing and margin conversations, and close the order.



On the marketing side, you will book and run your own 30-minute demos with realtors, contractors, and home-service business owners across Canada and the US. One owner may need a website, another may need advertising, and another may need SEO. Working out what they actually need is half the job. You will present the solution over screen share, explain what it costs and why it is worth it, answer objections, and ask for the sale.



You will also sell our subscription software. Some products already have customers; others will be brand new to the market. Depending on the product, you may be selling into entirely different industries and customer profiles. You must be comfortable learning a new market, understanding the outcome the product delivers, and building the sales approach without years of case studies or testimonials behind you.



Both companies rely heavily on outbound calling. You will build the entire pipeline yourself: researching prospects, creating lead lists, making calls, getting past gatekeepers, booking meetings, running demos, following up, and closing.



If you have only worked leads that someone else handed you, this position will not suit you.



Nobody is going to build the process for you either. If something in the pipeline is not working, we expect you to identify it, speak up, and help fix it.



## What You Will Own



* A self-generated pipeline across both companies

* New wholesale accounts, from the first cold call to the first purchase order

* Reorders and ongoing relationships for every wholesale account you open

* Every marketing or software demo you book—and the deal that comes from it

* Consistent follow-up until each opportunity is won, lost, or disqualified

* A CRM that accurately reflects what happened on every call, what comes next, and when

* Your daily activity, pipeline health, and sales results



## What You Bring



* Cold-calling ability that produces results. You can engage someone who did not ask to hear from you, hold their attention past the first ten seconds, and secure a clear next step.

* The ability to build targeted lead lists from scratch using Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Google Maps, or whatever tools you prefer. Nobody is handing you a finished list.

* Several years of experience closing B2B deals by phone and video, with real numbers you can walk us through.

* Confidence running live product demonstrations over screen share.

* Experience selling to owner-operators, independent retailers, or small-business buyers who may ask about price within the first two minutes.

* Clear, easy-to-understand spoken and written English. Our customers are in Canada and the US, and many will take your call from a job site or behind a retail counter.

* The discipline to manage your own desk without someone constantly checking in on you.

* Comfort selling something new. Some of our products are approaching launch, so you will need to sell the outcome without relying on an established name, years of case studies, or a library of testimonials.

* The resilience to handle rejection, adjust your approach, and keep making quality calls.



## Experience That Counts in Your Favour



We can train the right person, but the following experience would be an advantage:



* Selling software, SaaS, memberships, or other subscription products where customers pay monthly and can cancel

* Selling into real estate, including realtors, brokerages, contractors, and the trades

* Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, or a similar CRM

* Selling wholesale products to independent retailers

* Knowledge of websites, Google Ads, Meta Ads, or SEO enough to hold a credible conversation with an owner who may have been burned by an agency before

* Helping launch a new product or opening a market without an established sales playbook



## What We Offer



* CAD $8–$10 per hour, depending on experience

* Payment twice monthly

* 10% commission on everything you close, including wholesale orders, marketing services, and software

* For anything sold on a subscription basis, commission is calculated on the customer’s first month

* Expected total earnings of approximately CAD $2,150–$2,500 per month at target

* Uncapped commission

* Full-time, set working hours

* A fully remote team

* Direct access to the owners, without layers of management



The wholesale book is still young, which means the accounts you open are accounts that would not have existed without youand they are yours to develop into long-term customers.



There is also plenty to sell. You will have wholesale accounts on one side and websites, advertising, SEO, and a growing portfolio of subscription software on the other. A slower month in one area still leaves you with opportunities elsewhere in the pipeline.



More products are coming. Several subscription products are expected to launch over the next year, and you will be the first person responsible for selling them. That is a different challenge from inheriting a mature product with five years of case studies behind it, and we want someone who finds that opportunity exciting.



## How to Apply



Please send us all three of the following:



1. A 60–90 second voice introduction so we can hear how you communicate on a call. Tell us who you are, what you have sold, and why this role interests you.

2. Two or three sentences about the hardest deal you have ever closed, including what nearly killed it and how you got it across the line.

3. A short explanation of why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role.



We review every application ourselves. Applications that include all three items will be considered first.

description:
We are hiring a highly motivated **SEO Link Building Virtual Assistant** to help build the backlink authority of multiple U.S.-based websites in the real estate, mortgage, title, and related industries.



This position is primarily focused on one thing:



**Earning and building high-quality referring domains consistently.**



We are NOT looking for someone whose entire link-building strategy consists of purchasing cheap backlink packages.



We want someone who can research opportunities, build relationships, perform outreach, create profiles/citations, identify competitor backlinks, secure placements, and document every acquired link.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

You will be responsible for finding and securing backlink opportunities through strategies such as:



* Competitor backlink research

* Guest post outreach

* Resource-page outreach

* Link insertions

* Business directories

* Local citations

* Industry directories

* Association websites

* Chamber of Commerce opportunities

* Real estate directories

* Mortgage directories

* Local business websites

* Professional profiles

* Web 2.0 properties where appropriate

* HARO-style journalist opportunities

* Digital PR opportunities

* Broken-link building

* Unlinked brand mentions

* Local sponsorship opportunities

* Partner/vendor links

* Niche edits where appropriate

* Link reclamation



PRIMARY KPI

Your primary performance metric will be:

**NEW QUALITY REFERRING DOMAINS ACQUIRED**



We care much more about obtaining links from **new, legitimate referring domains** than generating hundreds of links from the same websites.



DOMAIN AUTHORITY TARGETS

Our preferred opportunities include:



**Tier 1**

* DR 70+



**Tier 2**

* DR 50–69



**Tier 3**

* DR 30–49



Our primary focus is **DR40+ websites**, with additional emphasis on DR50+ and DR70+ opportunities.



LINK QUALITY MATTERS

A backlink should ideally come from a website that is:



* Indexed by Google

* Receiving legitimate organic traffic

* Relevant to the website or location

* Not obviously created exclusively for selling links

* Not overloaded with spam

* Not part of an obvious PBN

* Not primarily casino/adult/pharmaceutical/spam content

* Capable of providing a crawlable link

* A new referring domain whenever possible



We will prioritize **quality + relevance + authority**, not just DR.



DAILY WORK MAY INCLUDE

* Analyze competitor backlink profiles

* Create prospecting lists

* Find contact information

* Send personalized outreach

* Follow up on previous outreach

* Negotiate placements

* Submit business profiles

* Build citations

* Find local backlink opportunities

* Monitor acquired links

* Verify that backlinks are live

* Record URLs and anchor text

* Track referring domains

* Update link-building spreadsheets

* Report daily KPI performance



SEO TOOLS

Experience with any of the following is preferred:



* Ahrefs

* Semrush

* Google Search Console

* Google Sheets

* Screaming Frog

* Moz

* Majestic

* Hunter

* Apollo

* ChatGPT

* Google advanced search operators



IDEAL CANDIDATE

You should:



* Understand backlinks and referring domains

* Understand Domain Rating / Domain Authority concepts

* Know the difference between a quality link and a spammy backlink

* Understand anchor text

* Know how to conduct competitor backlink analysis

* Be excellent at Google research

* Be comfortable with
 outreach

* Have strong written English

* Be persistent with follow-up

* Be highly organized

* Document your work accurately

* Be results-oriented



THIS POSITION IS NOT FOR YOU IF:

* You only know how to purchase Fiverr backlink packages

* You believe 1,000 low-quality backlinks are better than one authoritative link

* You cannot explain the difference between backlinks and referring domains

* You rely completely on automated backlink software

* You do not track your work

* You disappear when outreach does not receive immediate responses



PERFORMANCE WILL BE TRACKED

We track:



* Prospects researched

* Outreach messages sent

* Follow-ups completed

* Positive responses

* Links secured

* New referring domains

* DR of acquired domains

* Relevance

* Live-link rate

* Indexed-link rate

* Cost per acquired link where applicable



Top performers who consistently acquire authoritative referring domains will receive preference for **long-term employment, additional responsibility, and performance incentives.**



OUR GOAL

We operate multiple websites and intend to aggressively grow their organic authority and search visibility.



This means there is **a significant amount of long-term link-building work available** for the right person.



HOW TO APPLY

Please provide:

**If I gave you a real estate website today and asked you to acquire five new DR40+ referring domains, what would you do first?**



Finally, start your application with:



**“DR70”**



This tells us you actually read the entire job description.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a **long-term SEO team member and grow with our organization.**

title: VIDEO EDITOR (REMOTE – PHILIPPINES | PART-TIME)
description:
This Is NOT Just Another Editing Job



We are building something bigger than content. We are building a brand that dominates attention, builds trust instantly, and converts viewers into customers and clients across roofing, construction, and real estate.



If you are a high-level video editor who understands storytelling, pacing, and visual impact—and who knows how to leverage AI video tools to produce more, faster, without losing quality—keep reading.



Who We Are



We are a rapidly growing U.S.-based company operating across roofing and construction, real estate and property development, and media and community-based platforms. We move fast. We execute. And we expect excellence.



What We're Looking For



We are looking for a highly skilled, detail-oriented Video Editor (AI-Assisted) based in the Philippines who can create high-impact short-form and long-form content, generate and integrate AI-produced video, avatars, and B-roll into real client work, and turn raw footage into compelling, conversion-driven content. This is a part-time remote role, but performance-based growth opportunities are very real.



Requirements (Non-Negotiable)



First, you must be advanced in at least one major editing platform—CapCut at a high level, Adobe Premiere Pro, or Final Cut Pro. If you are not highly proficient in editing software, this role is not for you.



Second, and this is a major factor for us, you must have hands-on, proven experience generating video and visual assets with AI tools. We are talking about Veo 3 for cinematic text-to-video, Seedance for AI video generation, HeyGen for avatars and talking heads, Higgsfield for motion control and ad creative, Nano Banana for image generation and editing, and comparable platforms like Runway, Kling, Sora, ElevenLabs, or Midjourney. We actively use these tools in production every day. If you have never generated AI video and worked it into a real edit, this role is not for you. Please include AI-generated samples in your portfolio and tell us which tool produced which shot.



Your Responsibilities



On the editing side, you will cut short-form content for Reels, Shorts, and TikTok, along with long-form pieces for YouTube, brand videos, and interviews. That includes clean transitions, captions and subtitles, motion graphics, and sound design.



On the AI side, you will write effective prompts that produce usable footage rather than impressive tests. You will generate AI B-roll, product and property visuals, and scene fillers where live footage does not exist. You will build AI avatar and voiceover content for ads, explainers, and localized versions. Most importantly, you will blend AI-generated footage seamlessly with real footage so it reads as intentional, not artificial—upscaling, reframing, and cleaning up output until it is genuinely usable. Over time, you will help us track what works and build repeatable AI workflows.



You will also handle supporting design work: thumbnails, social visuals, and branding elements, all consistent with our brand style.



What Makes You a Strong Candidate



You understand storytelling, pacing, and viewer retention. You can make content feel modern, clean, and premium. You know the difference between AI footage that sells and AI footage that looks fake. You have an eye for detail and composition, you are fast and responsive and reliable, and you can follow direction while still bringing your own creative ideas. You also stay current as new tools launch, because this space changes monthly.



It is a bonus if you have edited construction, real estate, or business content before, if you understand short-form viral trends, if you know how to edit for engagement and conversions, or if you have built and documented an AI content workflow.



Work Style Expectations



This is a fast-paced environment. Clear communication is required. Deadlines matter, and quality matters more. We are not looking for average—we are looking for someone who takes pride in producing top-tier work consistently, and who sees AI as a way to do more of it.



How to Apply



Send us your portfolio or reel, at least two examples of AI-generated video you personally produced along with the tools used, and a short note on which AI tools you reach for most and why.

* Rental clients

* Realtors

s/documents

title: Flower Buyer / Remote Position

That last part is the piece most people get backwards. You do not need to walk in knowing the difference between a garden rose and a regular rose. We can teach that. . A lot of it, with vendors and with our team.

Claude and ChatGPT. Daily, not occasionally.

Our internal floral program for recipes and bulk buys. We will teach you this one.





Hours and location

Who we are looking for - MUST HAVE



Genuinely strong experience with Google Sheets. Formulas, lookups, data validation, conditional formatting, and the discipline to make a sheet look finished rather than functional.

Math in terms of pricing/cost and budgeting. You should like numbers, not tolerate them.

Already using AI tools and interested in where they are going. We will hand you an AI agent and expect you to run it well, notice when it is wrong, and help make it better.

Excellent written communication. This job is
, recipes, ClickUp comments, and clear notes. If you are remote, your writing is how we know what is happening.

Very organized, with real time management. We are an event related business, pop ups and tight deadlines are a real thing. You need to be able to self-manage your time and efficiency so that when the unexpected happens, you are still in control and can execute successfully.

Detail obsessive. A wrong cell in a spreadsheet becomes the wrong flowers in a hotel lobby.

Open to extending your knowledge of flowers. Curious about varieties, seasons, and what makes product good quality.



Would be nice to have but not required: 

Any floral, event, catering or hospitality background

Experience with ClickUp

Not required



Floral Design skill. This seat buys, it does not design.

What success looks like

First 30 days. You know the sheet and the rhythm. You are producing the buying list alongside someone else and it is coming out clean.



By 60 days. You own the list end to end for all product receiving days, plus our weekly hotel and lobby accounts. Invoice coding is fully yours.



By 90 days. You have automated at least two manual steps out of the weekly build, and you are the person who knows the numbers better than anyone else here.







What you can expect from us

We are a luxury floral studio in Los Angeles that has been around since 1999. We do the Beverly Hills Hotel, Hotel Bel-Air, the Four Seasons Beverly Wilshire, the Waldorf Astoria, weddings, and large events. Our work is beautiful and the pace is real. We execute high quality floral designs and need someone that can stay on top of the ordering and budgeting in real time.   



You can be trained on the flower side. You will be handed AI tools and encouraged to push on them. You will report directly to the owner and operations manager, which means when you find a better way to do something, there is nobody in between you and the decision.
