This is a remote position based in the Philippines with flexible working hours accommodating US business schedules.



Responsibilities: Develop innovative 2D and 3D design concepts for USB drive housings and SSD external enclosures; create premium graphic designs incorporating company branding, logos, and artistic elements; design luxury jewelry-quality finishes and material specifications; produce CAD-ready technical drawings and specifications for manufacturing partners; collaborate with product engineers to ensure designs meet manufacturing feasibility and durability standards; integrate AI design tools for rapid prototyping and iteration; validate designs through 3D rendering and visualization; manage design-to-production transitions with overseas manufacturing partners.



Required Experience:



2+ years in product design, industrial design, or luxury goods design

Expertise in 2D and 3D design (Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)

Proven experience with graphic design and visual branding

Portfolio demonstrating jewelry, luxury accessories, or premium IT product design

Proficiency in CAD software (SolidWorks, Fusion 360, AutoCAD, or similar)

Experience with AI design tools (Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, or generative design platforms)

Strong understanding of design for manufacturability (DFM)

Ability to create production-ready technical specifications

Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal)

Experience working remotely with international teams

Preferred Qualifications:



Background in luxury brand design or high-end consumer electronics

Experience designing security or technology products

Knowledge of material science and premium finishes (anodized aluminum, premium plastics, leather, metal plating)

Experience with 3D printing and prototype validation

Portfolio including jewelry or precious goods design

Web programming experience (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or similar – highly preferred) – Ability to create interactive design presentations, product configurators, or web-based design tools

Full-stack web development capabilities – Candidates with web design and development skills will be prioritized for enhanced compensation and leadership opportunities

title: Talent Sourcer / Recruitment Specialist – Australian Trades & Field Service
description:
# Talent Acquisition & People Coordinator



**Remote – Philippines**

**Part-Time: Approximately 20 Hours Per Week Initially**

**Long-Term Position With Opportunity to Increase Hours**

**US$7–10/hour depending on experience + performance incentives**



## About the Role



We are a growing Australian business based in Adelaide, South Australia, looking for an experienced **Talent Acquisition & People Coordinator** to take ownership of our recruitment pipeline and assist with employee onboarding, training administration and people operations.



This is intended to be a **long-term position**, not a short-term recruitment project.



Our immediate priority is recruiting reliable field-service technicians for our Australian operations. However, as our business grows, you will also assist with recruitment for administration, sales, technology, management and offshore positions.



We are specifically looking for someone with genuine professional experience in:



* Recruitment

* Talent acquisition

* Candidate sourcing

* Headhunting

* Passive candidate outreach

* Candidate screening

* HR/people administration



This is **not a general VA position**.



You will work directly with the business owner and progressively become responsible for maintaining our recruitment systems, candidate database, onboarding processes and employee administration.



---



# Your Primary Responsibility: Recruitment & Headhunting



Traditional job advertisements do not always produce the calibre of candidates we require.



A major part of your role will therefore involve **proactively finding and approaching people who are already successfully employed**, rather than simply waiting for job applications.



You will:



* Research and identify suitable candidates

* Build targeted candidate lists

* Use LinkedIn and other platforms for candidate sourcing

* Conduct Boolean searches

* Identify passive candidates

* Directly approach potential employees

* Send personalised candidate outreach

* Follow up prospective candidates

* Conduct initial screening interviews

* Review employment histories

* Assess employment stability

* Identify reasons for previous job changes

* Assess communication and cultural fit

* Shortlist suitable candidates

* Coordinate management interviews

* Conduct reference checks where requested

* Maintain detailed candidate records

* Build a long-term talent pipeline



Our current Australian field-service recruitment particularly values candidates with:



* Stable employment histories

* Mechanical aptitude

* Field-service experience

* Ability to work independently

* Good customer communication

* Reliability

* Strong work ethic

* Long-term career intentions



Direct industry experience is helpful but **not always required**, because we have developed our own structured training program.



---



# Talent Mapping



We want to develop our own internal talent database rather than starting recruitment from zero every time we need an employee.



You will systematically identify potential employees across industries including:



* Pool and spa servicing

* Irrigation

* Pumps

* Water treatment

* Pest control

* Maintenance

* Facilities management

* Landscaping

* Field service

* Appliance servicing

* Technical services

* Trades and related industries



You will maintain records including:



* Candidate name

* Current position

* Current employer

* Employment tenure

* Previous employment

* Location

* Skills

* Contact history

* Interest level

* Salary expectations where known

* Suitability

* Follow-up dates

* Interview history

* Recruitment notes



Some candidates may not be ready to move immediately.



Your responsibility will be to build relationships and maintain a pipeline so that suitable candidates can be approached again in the future.



---



# Recruitment Across Our Business



Over time, you may assist with recruitment for:



### Australian Operations



* Field Service Technicians

* Senior Technicians

* Supervisors

* Operations staff

* Sales employees

* Account managers

* Administration

* Management roles



### Philippines / Remote Team



* Virtual Assistants

* Customer service employees

* Developers

* Designers

* Marketing employees

* Sales staff

* Other remote contractors



### Technology Businesses



Our company is also developing software products and technology businesses.



You may assist with sourcing:



* Full-stack developers

* Mobile developers

* UI/UX designers

* QA testers

* Product staff

* Customer success employees

* Sales representatives



---



# Employee Onboarding



Once a candidate is hired, you will help coordinate their onboarding.



Responsibilities may include:



* Preparing onboarding checklists

* Collecting required employee information

* Coordinating employment documentation

* Ensuring documentation has been returned

* Reference-check administration

* Licence/check verification

* Coordinating uniforms and equipment

* Scheduling onboarding activities

* Creating employee files

* Creating internal accounts/checklists

* Coordinating training

* Following up incomplete onboarding tasks

* Ensuring new employees are ready before commencement



You will not be responsible for providing Australian employment-law advice or making legal employment decisions.



---



# Training & Learning Administration



We have developed our own internal technician training program.



You will help administer the training system by:



* Enrolling employees in training

* Tracking module completion

* Tracking quiz results

* Identifying overdue training

* Maintaining training records

* Coordinating practical assessments

* Recording competencies

* Maintaining employee training files

* Scheduling refresher training

* Producing training progress reports

* Following up employees who fall behind



You will work with management and technical staff who provide the technical training and assessments.



---



# Employee Review Administration



You will help ensure employee reviews happen consistently rather than being forgotten during busy periods.



This may include organising:



* 7-day check-ins

* 30-day reviews

* 60-day reviews

* 90-day/probation reviews

* Six-month reviews

* Annual reviews



You may:



* Prepare review documents

* Gather employee feedback

* Collect manager feedback

* Maintain records

* Track agreed actions

* Schedule follow-up reviews



Final performance decisions remain with management.



---



# Employee Retention



As the role develops, you may assist management in understanding why employees stay or leave.



This may include:



* Employee check-ins

* Satisfaction surveys

* Identifying recurring concerns

* Exit interviews

* Recording resignation reasons

* Reporting employee-retention trends

* Identifying potential retention risks

* Monitoring employee tenure



The objective is to identify problems early rather than discovering them only when an employee resigns.



---



# Recruitment Marketing



You may also help improve how our businesses present themselves to prospective employees.



This could include:



* Writing and maintaining job advertisements

* Updating recruitment templates

* Managing careers-page content

* Creating employee testimonials

* Coordinating recruitment social-media posts

* Managing employee-referral programs

* Reviewing competitor job advertisements

* Researching salary ranges

* Tracking which recruitment channels produce the best employees



---



# Recruitment Reporting



We want recruitment decisions to become data-driven.



You will maintain reporting on metrics such as:



* Candidates sourced

* Candidates contacted

* Response rate

* Screening interviews

* Management interviews

* Offers made

* Offers accepted

* Cost per hire

* Time to hire

* Source of successful candidates

* Probation success rate

* Employee retention

* Reasons candidates reject offers



You should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and recruitment databases.



---



# What We Are Looking For



You MUST have genuine recruitment, talent acquisition or candidate-sourcing experience.



Strong candidates will have experience with:



* LinkedIn Recruiter

* LinkedIn sourcing

* Boolean search

* Passive candidate sourcing

* Headhunting

* Cold candidate outreach

* Screening interviews

* Candidate databases / ATS systems

* Reference checking

* Recruitment reporting

* HR administration



Experience working with **Australian businesses** would be highly regarded.



Experience recruiting:



* Tradespeople

* Field-service employees

* Blue-collar workers

* Technical employees

* Engineers

* Construction workers

* Maintenance employees



would be particularly valuable.



---



# Personal Characteristics



We are looking for someone who is:



* Highly organised

* Proactive

* Persistent

* Comfortable approaching people

* An excellent written communicator

* Confident speaking with candidates

* Good at assessing people

* Detail-oriented

* Able to work independently

* Comfortable challenging poor-quality candidates rather than simply progressing everyone

* Interested in building systems rather than simply completing individual tasks



We value **quality over activity**.



Sending 100 generic LinkedIn messages is not success.



Finding five excellent potential employees is.



---



# Hours & Long-Term Opportunity



The role will initially involve approximately **20 hours per week**.



For the right person, there is potential for:



* Increased hours

* Additional responsibility

* Full-time employment

* Greater ownership of recruitment

* Progression toward a People Operations / Talent Acquisition leadership role



We want someone who can grow with the business over several years.



---



# Compensation



**US$7–10 per hour**, depending on demonstrated experience.



Additional performance incentives may be offered for outcomes including:



* Successful hires

* Difficult-to-fill roles

* Employees successfully passing probation

* Long-term employee retention



---



# How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following questions.



### 1.



How many years of professional recruitment, talent acquisition or candidate-sourcing experience do you have?



### 2.



Have you personally used LinkedIn Recruiter or LinkedIn to proactively identify passive candidates? Explain what you did.



### 3.



Have you recruited for Australian businesses before?



If yes, describe the industries and positions.



### 4.



Have you recruited tradespeople, technicians, field-service workers or blue-collar employees?



Provide examples.



### 5.



Explain how you would identify irrigation technicians in Adelaide, Australia, who have worked for their current employer for at least three years.



### 6.



Provide an example Boolean search string you could use to identify field-service technicians in Adelaide.



### 7.



Write a short example LinkedIn message you would send to a passive candidate who is currently employed and has not applied for our position.



### 8.



How do you assess whether someone is likely to become a stable long-term employee?



### 9.



Tell us about a difficult vacancy you successfully filled.



How did you find the successful candidate?



### 10.



What HR or employee-administration responsibilities have you previously handled?



### 11.



What recruitment software, ATS platforms and sourcing tools have you used?



### 12.



What is your expected hourly rate in USD?



Applications that provide generic answers without demonstrating genuine recruitment experience will not progress.

title: Real Estate Executive Assistant (Admin, Research & Prospecting Support)
description:
I am a real estate broker in Colorado, USA. I need a detail-obsessed assistant to own the administrative, research, and prospecting support side of my business so I can stay in front of clients.



This role is about accuracy and follow-through, not creativity. The single most important quality I am hiring for is this: when you tell me something is done, it is actually done.



WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Pull and format prospecting data into clean, ready-to-use call lists

- Build neighborhood and subdivision research briefs using a template I provide

- Compile market and comparable sales data into a set format

- Prepare listing presentation and pre-listing materials from existing templates

- Calendar management and appointment confirmation

- Inbox organization and flagging

- Data entry, list building, and online research

- Maintain trackers and update them daily without being asked

- General administrative support as my business grows



REQUIRED:

- 2+ years as a virtual assistant supporting a US-based business

- Excellent written English

- Strong Google Workspace skills, especially Sheets

- Genuine attention to detail. You will be tested on this.

- Reliable internet and power backup

- Available for a short daily check-in at the start of my business day

- Comfortable being shown exactly how I want something done, then doing it that way every time



NICE TO HAVE:

- US real estate experience

- Experience formatting or cleaning large data sets

- Familiarity with real estate prospecting platforms



HOW I WORK:

I give clear direction and I expect clear communication back. If something is going to be late, I want to hear it before the deadline, not after. Meet that standard and there is room for this to grow into a full-time role.



HOW I EXPECT YOU TO OPERATE:

One rule matters more than any other here: do not bring me a problem without bringing me at lease one proposed solution.



My measure for this role is simple. After I hand you something, I should not have to think about it again. If I am asking a second time, or waiting, or wondering where it stands, that is the problem I am hiring you to eliminate.



In practice that looks like:

- You spot bad data in a list and flag it with a fix, rather than delivering it and letting me find out

- You have done the same task ten times, so you build a checklist and stop needing instructions for it

- Something will be late, and I hear it from you before the deadline, not after

- You are unsure what I want, so you ask before you spend three hours, not after

- You notice something that needs doing and you do it, without being assigned



If you would rather be handed a task list every morning and work only from it, this is not the right role for you.



TIME TRACKING:

For your first 90 days, you will use TimeProof through OnlineJobs.ph. I want to be upfront about why: this is a new role and I do not yet have a good sense of how long each task actually takes. The tracking data is how I build realistic workloads and deadlines instead of guessing and setting you up to fail.



It is not there to police you. I judge this role on results, not on hours logged. After 90 days, once we both know what the work actually takes, we can revisit whether it stays on.



HOW TO APPLY:

Read this carefully. Applications missing any step will not be reviewed.



1. Begin your message with the word COMPASS so I know you read the full post.

2. Tell me about a specific time you caught a mistake that someone else missed. Be specific about what it was and how you found it.

3. List every research, spreadsheet, and project management tool you have actually used yourself.

4. Tell me how many other clients you currently work for, and roughly how many hours per week each one takes.

5. Tell me your internet speed and whether you have a backup power source.

6. Confirm you can work the schedule listed above.

7. Confirm you are comfortable using TimeProof during your first 90 days.

8. Answer this scenario in a few sentences. I ask you to build me a call list from a data export by tomorrow morning. Halfway through, you realize roughly 15% of the records have obviously wrong phone numbers, and I am unreachable in appointments. What do you actually do?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short PAID data accuracy test before any offer is made.

title: Graphic Designer (Web Design + Ad Creative)
description:
About the Role



We are an SEO agency serving local service businesses and ecommerce brands across the US. We are hiring a full-time Graphic Designer who can build beautiful, conversion-focused websites and brand assets for our clients, with SEO built into every page from the start rather than bolted on afterward.



This is not a "make it pretty" design role. You will be building real pages, mainly on WordPress with some Wix and Squarespace, that are designed to rank and convert. You will also create ad creative for paid campaigns and support our internal marketing materials.



If you like ownership, variety, and seeing your work drive actual results for real businesses, this is a good fit.



What You'll Own



1. Client Website and Page Design



Design and build client website pages on WordPress, Wix, and Squarespace

Structure pages with SEO fundamentals in mind: heading hierarchy, image optimization, page speed, mobile responsiveness, and internal linking opportunities

Mock up new website designs for existing clients and for new SEO sites

Work from client briefs and brand direction to create pages that look professional and turn visitors into leads



2. Ad Creative



Create ad graphics for paid campaigns, including static display ads, social ad creative, and multiple variations for A/B testing. Work on campaign creative, which means you should be comfortable taking direction and turning around several concepts quickly.



3. Brand Guidelines and Identity



Build brand guideline documents for new clients as they onboard, covering color palettes, typography, logo usage, and voice and tone direction. Create brand systems from scratch for companies that do not have one. Keep every page and asset we produce for a client visually consistent.



4. Speed and Systems



Use automation and AI tools to build pages faster. We are not looking for someone who designs every page by hand from scratch. We want someone who builds reusable templates and components, works efficiently inside page builders and automation tools, and is always looking for ways to cut production time without cutting quality.



5. Internal Design



Support internal marketing design, including social graphics, ad creative, presentation decks, and sales materials

Help keep the brand sharp across every touchpoint.



What We Need From You

- Several years of real design experience. Not a beginner, and not "I took a course." We need someone who has actually shipped client work.

- A portfolio you can show us. This is required with your application, not optional. No portfolio, no consideration.

- Strong working knowledge of WordPress, Wix, and Squarespace page building

- A practical understanding of on-page SEO. You do not need to be a technical SEO expert, but you should know why heading structure, alt text, and page speed matter.

- Hands-on experience with automation, AI design tools, or templating systems to speed up output. Tell us specifically which tools you use and how they have cut your turnaround time.

- Confidence building brand guidelines from scratch for a brand new client

- Strong written and verbal English communication

- Add design26 to your application to be considered

- Reliable, deadline-driven, and able to manage several client projects at once



Bonus Skills



- Shopify store design and theme customization

- Logo design for clients who need one built from the ground up

- Familiarity with Claude's AI design features as part of your workflow



Schedule and Pay



Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time

Base Pay: $1,000 per month



Bonuses on top of base for:

- Client retention

- Completed tasks and fast project turnaround

- Exceptional work quality

- Shopify design projects

- Use of Claude's AI design tools in your workflow



How to Apply



Send all of the following:

- Your resume or CV

- Your design portfolio, with the link included directly in your application

- A short cover note explaining why you are a strong fit for this specific role

- A section titled "Why I Stand Out." This is your chance to show us what separates you from every other applicant. Be specific, be confident, and point us to your best work.



Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.



By applying, you consent to us reviewing your portfolio and application materials, and contacting any references you provide.



We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us. Real client work, real creative ownership, and a clear path to more responsibility and more pay as you prove yourself.

title: Social Media Content Expert – Viral Growth
description:
**Social Media Content Expert – Viral Growth | Salon (Remote – US Luxury Brand)**



Parlour, a boutique luxury salon brand in the United States looking for a high-performing Social Media Content Expert who specializes in creating trending, viral content that drives real growth across platforms.



This is not a basic posting or scheduling role.



We need someone who understands how to make content that performs — content that gets shared, saves, comments, and new followers.



The Role

- Produce and edit short-form video and photo content (YouTube Shorts, Pinterest, TikTok and more)

- Post and schedule consistently across all platforms, keeping a steady, reliable cadence

- Direct and repurpose one shoot into content built for each platform's format and audience

- Read native analytics and identify what's working, what isn't, and what to double down on

- Build and manage paid campaigns from your best-performing organic content

- Keep everything aligned to a refined, luxury brand standard



Your main responsibility is simple: produce content that trends, travels, and grows the brand.



**What Success Looks Like**

- Content that consistently outperforms on reach and engagement

- A clear, evidence-based read on why specific pieces travel — not just a feeling 

- Organic winners systematically converted into paid ads that perform

- Steady, compounding account growth



**Tools You’ll Use**

CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Lightroom, Canva, DaVinci Resolve, and native platform analytics (Instagram Insights, TikTok Analytics, YouTube Analytics, Meta Business Suite. YouTube Studio, Pintrest Business Manager).



**Who We’re Looking For**

-3+years creating content for brands (beauty, lifestyle, or luxury a strong plus)

- Proven experience growing accounts through content that actually performs

- Genuinely understands platform analytics and can turn data into decisions

- Strong editing and fast creative output

- A refined aesthetic sense that fits a luxury brand

- Comfortable with EST hours (flexible 8am–8pm)



**Bonus:** experience running paid social, and familiarity with AI/automation tools.



**Details**

Part-time to start (5–20 hours per week) at $6/hour USD.

High performers will be considered for increased hours and full-time.



**How to Apply**

Only complete applications will be reviewed. Please include:

1. Today's date at the top

2. A short note on how hair, beauty, and luxury inspire the content you create — and why you're right for a US luxury brand

3. Your resume, portfolio (with examples of content that *performed* — bring the numbers), and
 address



**Our process is designed to respect your time:**

If you appear to be a good match for this role you will be invited to complete a brand analysis, which could lead to a video interview and potential paid trial.

Parlour is an equal opportunity employer. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Outbound Cold Caller/ Appointment Setter - Life Insurance
description:
We are looking for a confident and experienced Outbound Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to contact U.S. leads and consistently book appointments for a licensed life insurance agent.



MAIN GOAL



Your job is simple:



CALL LEADS ? CREATE INTEREST ? BOOK APPOINTMENTS



We provide the leads. You do NOT need to find or purchase leads.



Many of the people you contact already have life insurance. Your goal is to create interest in speaking with our licensed agent about their current coverage and whether other available options may be a better fit for them.



The licensed agent's primary appointment availability is:



Monday–Thursday | 2:00 PM – 8:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time 



Your main objective is to consistently fill these available appointment slots with qualified prospects.



RESPONSIBILITIES

Make outbound calls to leads we provide.

Speak confidently and professionally with U.S. consumers.

Generate interest in having their existing life insurance coverage reviewed and compared with available options.

Handle basic objections and keep the conversation moving toward an appointment.

Number of outbound calls

Appointments booked

Appointment show rate

Quality of appointments

title: Remote Sales Rep / Appointment Setter | $1,200+ Monthly Earning Potential + Uncapped Bonuses
description:
Remote Sales Rep / Appointment Setter | $1,200+ Monthly Earning Potential + Uncapped Bonuses



Are you good at sales, confident on the phone, and motivated by the opportunity to make more money based on your performance?



We are a growing US-based short-term rental property management company looking for a hungry, resourceful Sales Representative to help us grow our portfolio.



This is a 100% performance-based role with uncapped earning potential.



Our target is for a successful rep to earn $1,200+ USD per month, with the opportunity to earn significantly more as you generate larger clients and build your pipeline.



What Are You Selling?



We provide full-service management for Airbnb and short-term rental property owners.

Our clients own the properties and pay their ownership expenses.

We handle essentially everything else.

Guest communication, pricing, revenue optimization, cleaning, maintenance coordination, supplies, listing management, property operations, and more.



Our ideal clients are property owners who:



Currently use another management company but aren't happy with their results

Own short-term rentals but are tired of managing everything themselves

Live outside the city and need a trusted local team

Own multiple properties and want a better management partner



Your goal is simple:



Find great potential clients, start conversations, qualify the opportunity, and get them on a call with our team.



How You Make Money



We want this position to reward RESULTS.



Qualified Meetings ? You Get Paid



Book a qualified meeting with a legitimate property owner who fits our criteria and attends the call, and you earn a flat appointment fee.



We Sign the Client ? You Get Paid AGAIN



If your lead becomes a client, you receive an additional bonus based on the size of the opportunity.



Recurring Management Client ? Bigger Bonus



If the client signs an ongoing property management agreement, you receive an additional bonus equal to 50% of our first month's management revenue from that client.



The bigger the opportunity you bring us, the more money you can make.



Our initial target for a successful rep is approximately 6–8 qualified meetings per month and 1–3 new clients per month.



We are targeting approximately $1,200+ USD/month in earnings for a productive rep, but there is no fixed earnings ceiling.



Who We're Looking For



You don't need to be an Airbnb expert.



We can teach you our business.



What we DO need is someone who can sell.



You should be:



Confident speaking English with US customers

Comfortable cold calling

Experienced in sales, appointment setting, lead generation, or business development

Resourceful enough to research and find potential customers

Persistent with follow-up

Comfortable hearing "no"

Competitive and motivated by commission

Organized with your pipeline

Hungry to make money and grow with a company



Previous experience in US sales, real estate, Airbnb, hospitality, property management, or B2B sales is a big plus.



Why This Opportunity Is Different



We aren't selling a $20 product.



One good conversation can turn into a client worth thousands of dollars per year to our company.



Some owners have one property.



Others have 5, 10, or more.



That's why we want our sales rep participating in the upside.



Find better opportunities. Build relationships. Bring us valuable clients. Make more money.



As you prove yourself, there will also be opportunities to take on more of the sales process and earn larger commissions.



How to Apply



Send us through WhatsApp: 
A short introduction about yourself

Your previous sales experience

Your cold-calling experience

The biggest sale or client you've helped generate

Why you prefer a performance-based opportunity

A 60–90 second video recording introducing yourself and telling us why you think you'd be good at this role



Please start your application with the words "LET'S GROW" so we know you read the entire post.



We're looking for someone who wants more than just another online job.



If you're confident in your ability to generate business and want your income tied to your results, we want to hear from you.
